name: travel-desk
description: A travel agent's desk on top of the Travel Hacking Toolkit. Keep a file on every client (home airports, points balances, preferences), run a points-vs-cash consult for a client trip, turn it into a client-ready proposal, record bookings, and audit every client's upcoming trips for price drops, schedule changes, and better cabins. Try: '/travel-desk:consult hendersons Rome in May, business class for two'.
